home.title: You're probably solving the wrong problem
home.description: Amoris is a founder-led AI GTM agency. Most GTM problems are misdiagnosed. I work across sales, marketing, product, analytics and ML to tell founders which problem is actually theirs - then build the system around it.
home.hero-title: You're probably solving the wrong problem
home.hero-sub-slogan: Your sales lead says it's lead quality. Marketing says it's follow-up. Product says it's positioning. Each is right about their part, and none of them can see the whole thing. I have worked in all of it - sales, marketing, product, analytics and ML - and the most useful thing I do is tell founders which problem is actually theirs.
home.references: A decade of finding patterns, designing systems and driving revenue
